taijasa
(‘one who is bright’)
------------------------------------------
The जीव (the individual सोउल्) has three states of consciousness—jāgrat (waking state), स्वप्न (dream state) and सुषुप्ति (deep-sleep state).
He is called viśva, तैजस and प्राज्ञ respectively when associated with these three states.
See also PRĀJÑA.
